# E0332: a mapping has an attribute

Nothing attaches to a mapping. A lacuna is declared in the lens's lacunas
field, keyed by the mapping it describes, not as an attribute on the mapping.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	firstfield: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	firstfield:  string
	secondfield: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		secondfield: -1 @lacuna(Placeholder, "-1 is a placeholder")
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	firstfield:  string
	secondfield: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0332]: a mapping has no attributes; a lacuna is declared in the lens's lacunas field, keyed by the mapping
 --> history/1.0.thema:9:19
  |
9 |         secondfield: -1 @lacuna(Placeholder, "-1 is a placeholder")
  |                         ^
  |
```
